create_Sam3VideoInference: create a Sam3VideoInference model instance for video object segmentation and tracking
run_Sam3VideoInference_propagate_in_vide: run video propagation on a Sam3VideoInference model to segment and track objects across all frames
add_Sam3VideoInference_prompt: add a text or box prompt to a Sam3VideoInference model on a specific frame for object grounding
init_Sam3VideoInference_state: initialize inference state from a video or image resource path for Sam3VideoInference
create_Sam3VideoInferenceWithInstanceInt: create a Sam3VideoInferenceWithInstanceInteractivity model for interactive object tracking with point refinement
run_Sam3VideoInference_warm_up_compilati: run warm-up compilation on a Sam3VideoInference model to cache torch.compile traces before inference
run_Sam3VideoInference_reset_state: reset a Sam3VideoInference inference state to its initial empty configuration
run_Sam3VideoInference_remove_object: remove an object from a Sam3VideoInferenceWithInstanceInteractivity tracker state by object id
